Galar_Spectral_Bear_Wings.description: Emerging from the spectral essence of ancient Ursine warriors, the Galar Spectral Bear Wings are ghostly appendages that grant the wielder the ability to glide through the air with eerie silence and precision, their magic imbued with the wisdom of the ages and the agility of the wind.

Owlbear_Feathered_Wings.description: Bristling with feathered wings that defy the creature's bearlike bulk, the owlbear soars through the skies with an unnatural grace, its agile movements and swift flight compensating for its formidable strength and imposing presence.

Bat_Bear_Leathery_Wings.description: These leathery wings, a strange evolutionary twist on the bear's anatomy, grant the creature the uncanny ability to soar through the air with unmatched agility and precision, while also enhancing its senses to detect the faintest of sounds and movements from high above.

Fae_Bear_Gossamer_Wings.description: Emerging from the dense, ethereal mists of the fae realm, the Fae_Bear_Gossamer_Wings component bestows upon the bear-like creature a pair of delicate, shimmering wings that pulse with a vibrant, otherworldly glow, granting it the grace and agility to soar through the air with supernatural ease and charm.

Dragon_Bear_Scaled_Wings.description: Enormous, scaled wings sprout from the mighty back of this fearsome creature, blending the might of a dragon with the raw power of a bear, granting it the ability to soar through the skies while also providing formidable natural armor and strength in combat.

Sloth_Bear_Gliding_Membranes.description: Beneath the dense canopy of the treacherous forest, the sloth bear has evolved a pair of delicate, translucent gliding membranes that unfurl from its shoulder blades, granting it the grace to navigate the treetops with ease and a constitution that resists the harsh winds, allowing it to climb and glide with unparalleled agility and resilience.

Angel_Bear_Feathered_Wings.description: Brimming with otherworldly grace and an aura of serene power, the Angel_Bear's feathered wings are a marvel of celestial and earthly magic, granting it both the wisdom and charisma to command respect and the agility to soar through the skies with unparalleled elegance.

Demon_Bear_Leathery_Wings.description: Leathery wings sprout from the demon bear’s massive shoulders, a grotesque appendage that grants it the ability to take to the skies, its formidable strength amplified in flight, while its imposing presence and terrifying roar cut through the air with chilling authority.

Zombie_Bear_Rotten_Wings.description: The Zombie_Bear_Rotten_Wings, a twisted amalgamation of necrotic and bestial elements, unfurls its tattered, toxic wings, spreading a noxious cloud as it shuffles through the skies, its clumsy flight a testament to its cursed existence.

Spirit_Bear_Ethereal_Wings.description: Emerging from the spectral essence of ancient forests, the Spirit Bear Ethereal Wings is a haunting figure, its translucent wings a blend of magic and bone, granting it silent flight and an eerie, undying presence that whispers secrets of the grave while its innate wisdom and stealth allow it to move unseen through the shadows of the night.
